description: DETLUN crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21. Reported CIF formula moiety: C97 H84 Dy4 N12 Na2 O28,2(C2 H3 N1),3(C1 H4 O1),10(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.677-3.713 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 92.04-109.50°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4Na2L2(μ2-OH)2(PhCOO)8(CH3OH)(H2O)]·CH3CN·2CH3OH·7H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
